faqs.question: What is VCX-130 used for?
faqs.answer: VCX-130 is a 130 W, 20 kHz ultrasonic processor used for cell lysis, microsample processing, and plant tissue disruption, covering volumes from 150 µL to 150 mL depending on the probe used.

faqs.question: What volume can the standard probe process?
faqs.answer: The included ¼" titanium alloy probe handles 10 to 50 mL directly, with microtip accessories available for volumes down to 150 µL.

faqs.question: Is the VCX-130 probe autoclavable?
faqs.answer: Yes, the standard Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy probe is autoclavable, supporting sterile sample workflows.

faqs.question: Does VCX-130 display delivered energy?
faqs.answer: Yes, a digital wattmeter and energy monitor display power and delivered energy in real time throughout a run.

faqs.question: Can I run intermittent pulses on VCX-130?
faqs.answer: Yes, an independent ON/OFF pulser is adjustable from 1 to 59 seconds per cycle for fine intermittent control.

faqs.question: Is VCX-130 compatible with footswitch or remote operation?
faqs.answer: Yes, the system supports both remote actuation and footswitch operation for hands-free processing.

faqs.question: How does VCX-130 compare to VCX-500 or VCX-750?
faqs.answer: VCX-130 offers the same core programmability as the larger VCX models, at a lower 130 W power ceiling suited specifically to small and micro-scale sample volumes.

faqs.question: Can VCX-130 process plant tissue samples?
faqs.answer: Yes, soft, fresh plant tissue can typically be disrupted by sonicating in a lysis buffer, while harder, woody tissue may need freezing and grinding in liquid nitrogen first.

longForm.heroHook: 130 watts, full VCX programmability, built for the smallest sample volumes.
longForm.heroLead: Micro-scale sonication doesn't need less precision, it needs the same control in a smaller footprint. VCX-130 is Sonics & Materials' most popular small-volume system for exactly that reason. A 130 W, 20 kHz processor, it offers the same programmability as the larger VCX versions, with a digital wattmeter, energy monitor, automatic amplitude compensation, and a ten-hour timer paired with an independent 1 to 59 second ON/OFF pulser. A ¼" titanium alloy probe, handling 10 to 50 mL volumes, ships standard, with accessories available to extend processing down to 150 µL.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: VCX-130 product information: power delivery, control features, and probe options.
body: The system runs at 130 W net power output and 20 kHz frequency, offering the same programmability as the larger VCX-500 and VCX-750 systems in a smaller-volume format.
A digital wattmeter and energy monitor display power and delivered energy in real time throughout a run.
Automatic tuning and automatic amplitude compensation keep output consistent as sample conditions change during processing.
The ten-hour timer covers short bursts through extended runs, while an independent ON/OFF pulser, adjustable from 1 to 59 seconds on each cycle, adds fine control over intermittent sonication.
An elapsed time indicator and variable power output control round out the standard feature set.
The standard ¼" (6mm) titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V probe handles 10 to 50 mL volumes and is autoclavable for sterile workflows.
Remote actuation and footswitch operation are both supported, useful for hands-free processing.
The system ships complete with the probe, tool kit, and instruction manual, ready for operation out of the box.

sections.title: Energy Monitoring and Precision Control
sections.description: A small-volume sonicator lives or dies on precision, since there's far less margin for error in a 150 µL sample than in a full-liter batch. The digital wattmeter and energy monitor track power and delivered energy continuously during a run, so exactly how much energy a sample received is never a guess. Automatic tuning and amplitude compensation adjust output on the fly as sample viscosity, temperature, or composition shifts mid-process, keeping delivered energy consistent even when the sample itself isn't perfectly uniform. The independent ON/OFF pulser, adjustable in 1-second increments from 1 to 59 seconds, gives fine control over intermittent cycling for samples sensitive to continuous sonication.

sections.title: Probe and Volume Range
sections.description: The standard probe covers a solid working range on its own, and accessories extend that range further in either direction depending on what your samples actually need.
body: The included ¼" (6mm) titanium alloy probe handles 10 to 50 mL directly, autoclavable for workflows that require repeated sterilization between samples. For volumes below that range, down toward 150 µL, dedicated microtip and smaller-diameter probe accessories are available, suited to precious or limited-quantity samples. On the higher end, up to 150 mL, alternative probe configurations extend coverage without stepping up to a higher-power VCX model. An air-cooled converter option is also available for labs running longer or more frequent processing cycles where heat buildup in the converter itself becomes a factor.
